text.tspan: Semantic navigation — how humans traverse conceptual space — is
traditionally measured as clustering (exploiting a sub-category)

g.text: Frame semantic retrieval as a trajectory through embedding space

text.tspan: Minimal human intervention — no manual category labeling required.
Applicable across languages, tasks, and embedding models.
Each word is embedded as the full prefix up to step t,

g.text: The best approach depends on trajectory length:
Italian PLT: up to 107 sig. pairs (non-c.)
German PLT: up to 137 sig. pairs
Too little context → non-cumul. retains signal
Both approaches are complementary — trajectory length determines the best representation.
